verdict.rationale: Kong ships decK, a dedicated CLI explicitly built for API Lifecycle Automation (APIOps) to orchestrate and automate declarative config workflows, plus supports declarative and databaseless deployment and Admin API driven config sync, all of which map directly to GitOps style CI driven infrastructure management. Kong Gateway's DB-less mode and decK's sync commands are core, well documented features designed for exactly this use case. Missing for 10: independent or community case study of a full CI pipeline using decK, and explicit versioned rollback or diff workflow documentation in the evidence pack.
